sections.title: Quick Reference: When to Use What
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        DECISION TREE                                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                              │
│  Is your task...                                                            │
│       │                                                                      │
│       ├── CPU-bound? (calculations, data processing)                        │
│       │       │                                                              │
│       │       └── YES ──► Use MULTIPROCESSING                               │
│       │                   (bypasses GIL, true parallelism)                  │
│       │                                                                      │
│       └── I/O-bound? (network, disk, database)                              │
│               │                                                              │
│               ├── Few concurrent operations?                                │
│               │       └── Use THREADING                                     │
│               │           (simpler, good for 10-100 connections)            │
│               │                                                              │
│               └── Many concurrent operations? (100s-1000s)                  │
│                       └── Use ASYNCIO                                       │
│                           (scales better, less memory per connection)       │
│                                                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────┬─────────────────┬─────────────────┬─────────────────────┐
│    Criteria     │   Threading     │ Multiprocessing │      AsyncIO        │
├─────────────────┼─────────────────┼─────────────────┼─────────────────────┤
│ Best for        │ I/O-bound       │ CPU-bound       │ I/O-bound (many)    │
│ Memory          │ Shared          │ Separate        │ Shared              │
│ GIL impact      │ Limited by GIL  │ Bypasses GIL    │ Limited by GIL      │
│ Overhead        │ Low             │ High            │ Very Low            │
│ Complexity      │ Medium          │ High            │ Medium-High         │
│ Debugging       │ Hard            │ Harder          │ Different           │
│ Max connections │ ~100s           │ ~10s-100s       │ ~10,000s            │
└─────────────────┴─────────────────┴─────────────────┴─────────────────────┘
```
